description: This Java class provides generic DAO support for JPA operations, including entity retrieval, saving, updating, deleting, querying, and counting entities. It offers utility methods for building and executing criteria queries, with Spring annotations for repository and transaction management.

classes.name: SalesManagerJpaDaoSupport
classes.description: A generic JPA DAO support class that encapsulates common database operations such as CRUD, queries, and entity management, designed for reuse across different entity types.

methods.name: buildTypedQuery
methods.description: Creates a TypedQuery from a CriteriaQuery with optional limit and offset.

methods.name: filterCriteriaQuery
methods.description: Applies a filter expression to a CriteriaQuery.

methods.name: rootCriteriaQuery
methods.description: Creates a root for CriteriaQuery based on the entity class.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by class and identifier.

methods.name: getByField
methods.description: Retrieves an entity based on a specific field's value.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a managed entity or merges a detached one.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an entity from the database.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the state of the entity from the database.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes pending changes to the database.

methods.name: listEntity
methods.description: Lists entities with optional filtering, ordering, limit, and offset.

methods.name: listEntityByField
methods.description: Lists entities filtered by a specific field value.

methods.name: countEntity
methods.description: Counts total entities of a class.

methods.name: countEntityByField
methods.description: Counts entities filtered by a specific field value.

methods.name: getSingleResultOrNull
methods.description: Returns a single result from a CriteriaQuery or TypedQuery, or null if none found.

methods.name: getEntityManager
methods.description: Provides access to the EntityManager instance.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts a list of entities using their natural ordering.
